Name: Overgrown Fairy Buildings
Author: naeldeus
Description:
a content patcher conversion of ali's overgrown fairy buildings! compatible with 1.4.

[b][size=4]features:[/size]
[/b]
[list]
[*]a content packer version for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/494]overgrown fairy buildings[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34430155]ali[/url]﻿
[*]added a well, a mill and a shed in the same style
[*]an alternative slime hutch design based on the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4544]enchanted garden buildings[/url]﻿
[*][i]new [/i]upgrading the shed to the big shed won't revert it to vanilla anymore
[/list]
[b][size=4]installation:
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]download and install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher
[*]drop the content of this zip file in your Mods[i] [/i]folder
[*]edit the config file from SlimeOriginal to SlimeAlt for the alternate slime hutch, if you wish to use that
[*]that's it, have fun!
[/list]
[b][size=4]credits:[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]ali for her original buildings and for letting me update her mods
[/list][size=4]
[b]check out these other mods:[/b][/size]

[list]

[/list]
